how-to-check-a-cssbuy-product-link.title: How to Check a CSSBuy Product Link Before Ordering
how-to-check-a-cssbuy-product-link.seoTitle: CSSBuy Product Link Checklist: Seller, Size & Price
how-to-check-a-cssbuy-product-link.description: Check a CSSBuy product link against the original seller, selected size, configured price and QC evidence you will need before paying.

cssbuy-restrictions-brands-batteries-liq.description: Can CSSBuy ship your item? Check brands, batteries, liquids and mixed parcels against purchase rules, route limits and destination requirements before paying.

quickAnswer.title: Can CSSBuy buy it, store it and ship it? Check each separately.
paragraphs: A product appearing in a spreadsheet or reaching the warehouse does not confirm that an international route will accept it. Check the exact item and destination in the current service conditions. For batteries, state whether they are loose or installed; for liquids, record composition and volume. Ask about unclear attributes before payment and use accurate descriptions.

For a mixed parcel, every item must meet the chosen route’s conditions. Compare eligible combined and separate options only after screening the contents. A route label is not a promise about customs acceptance, and declaring a different product is not a valid workaround.

quickAnswer.title: Arrived, under inspection or ready for your decision?
paragraphs: “Arrived” records a warehouse stage; “undergoing quality inspection” does not mean you have approved the item or paid international shipping. Match the order number, then look for the actual QC evidence. Once available, compare the purchased option, quantity and visible condition before choosing to keep, clarify or request a return.

If the evidence is incomplete, ask for the specific view or measurement that would resolve the decision. If a mismatch is already visible, contact support on that order promptly and confirm the seller’s deadline. Keep the storage deadline separate from the return window, and do not infer a fixed processing time from another shopper’s experience.

quickAnswer.title: Use one deadline record for each item
paragraphs: Before waiting for more purchases, record each item’s arrival, current storage deadline, QC decision and seller return conditions. Do not assume that a storage allowance is a return period or that a new arrival restarts an older item’s clock. Confirm unclear dates with support using the relevant order reference.

Consolidate accepted items after choosing their protection. Compare the packed parcel’s actual weight and dimensions with the eligible routes; adding one item can change both the size and the available options. Resolve pending returns before paying to send those items internationally.

quickAnswer.title: This calculator compares weight; it does not quote freight
paragraphs: Enter the packed parcel’s actual weight and exterior dimensions, then use the divisor and billing increment shown for your selected route. The worksheet helps explain the weight calculation. It has no live rates and does not confirm whether the route accepts your contents or destination.

Use the result to compare packing scenarios with the same protection needs. Then obtain a current quote from CSSBuy with the complete parcel details. Keep product cost, Chinese delivery, optional services and destination charges in separate budget rows.

cssbuy-shipping-cost-planning.description: Budget CSSBuy shipping costs with separate product, domestic delivery, packing, international freight and destination-charge totals. Start with packed weight and dimensions.

quickAnswer.title: Calculate the complete cost in separate stages
paragraphs: Start with the chosen goods and Chinese delivery. Add any confirmed service and packing costs, then obtain international freight for the packed parcel and eligible route. Estimate destination charges separately under the current rules. Do not treat a displayed product price or early shipping estimate as the delivered total.
